caption_en:
One of these is the same word in Hebrew.

What countries in the Middle East and Africa call themselves:
Egypt: Masr / Misr (مصر), the same Semitic root as Hebrew Mitzrayim; "Egypt" comes from Greek Aigyptos
Morocco: al-Maghrib (المغرب), "the west"
Algeria: al-Jazā'ir (الجزائر), "the islands", after the islets off Algiers
Eswatini: renamed from Swaziland in April 2018
Türkiye: the UN name since June 2022
Iran (ایران): in 1935 Iran asked other countries to use Iran instead of Persia
Jordan: al-Urdun (الأردن)
Lebanon: Lubnān (لبنان), from a Semitic root for "white", for the snow on Mount Lebanon
Israel: Yisra'el (ישראל), the name given to Jacob in Genesis 32:28, often read as "he struggles with God"

Every country gets to name itself.
Part 3 (Asia) on my profile. Part 1 (Europe) too.

Sources: Wikipedia, List of countries and dependencies and their capitals in native languages; Names of Egypt; Algeria; Eswatini; Turkey; Name of Iran; Lebanon; Israel (2026). Genesis 32:28.
Voice: AI clone of my own voice.
caption_he:
אחד מהשמות האלה הוא אותה מילה בעברית.

מצרים היא מַצְר (אותו שורש כמו המילה העברית מצרים), מרוקו היא אל-מגרב ("המערב"), אלג'יריה היא אל-ג'זאיר ("האיים"), סווזילנד הפכה לאסוואטיני ב-2018, טורקיה ביקשה מהאו"ם לומר טורקיֶה ב-2022, פרס ביקשה מהעולם לומר איראן ב-1935, ירדן היא אל-אורדון, לבנון היא לובנאן ("לבן", על השלג בהרים), וישראל היא ישראל, השם שניתן ליעקב בספר בראשית.
חלק 3 בפרופיל.

lines.line: Egyptians say Masr. Hebrew has Mitzrayim, from the same old root. Egypt comes from Greek.
Fly west. Morocco is al-Maghrib: the west, where the sun sets.
Algeria is al-Jazair. The islands, after the islets off Algiers.
Way down south, Swaziland renamed itself Eswatini in 2018.
Turkey asked the UN to say Türkiye in 2022.
Persia? Iranians always said Iran. In 1935, they asked the world to say it too.
Lebanon is Lubnan, from an old word for white: the snow on its mountains.
And Israel is Yisrael. In Genesis, it's the name given to Jacob, often read as: he struggles with God.
Which one did you already know?
Part 3 flies to Asia. Until then, remember:
